visual.general_description: Color fundus photograph with the optic disc at the left side and a small round dark red-brown spot right of centre on a pale background.
visual.detailed_description: Round color fundus photograph with black corners and no printed text, labels, arrows or scale. The optic disc lies at the left side of the field with a pale yellowish centre and red-orange rim, and several retinal vessels branch from it across the field. A small round dark red-brown spot is visible right of centre, well away from the disc. The surrounding retina looks pale and slightly hazy compared with the more orange tone near the disc. Vessels appear as thin branching dark red lines; no emboli, hemorrhages or other discrete lesions are distinguishable at this resolution.

visual.general_description: Screenshot of OCT angiography software showing four en face angiogram slabs, four matching en face OCT images and two cross-sectional B-scans, labeled Left / OS.
visual.detailed_description: Software screenshot on a light grey background. Header text reads Angio Structure-Function at upper left and Left / OS at upper right; centred text reads Scan Quality 3/10 and 6.00 x 6.00 Scan Size (mm). The right-hand control column shows buttons Exit, Print, Export Angio and Reset View, checkboxes Invert, Color, Show Lines (checked), Show Bnd (checked) and Auto Zoom (checked), and radio options Angio, OCT and Angio / OCT (selected), with two magnifier icons. Top row: four square black-and-white en face angiograms; the first (blue outline) shows a branching vessel network with a small dark round gap at the crosshair, the second shows a less dense network with dark patches and a bright granular zone near the crosshair, the third is almost entirely black, and the fourth is speckled with a bright white spot at the crosshair. Captions beneath the second row read Angio / OCT - Superficial, - Deep, - Outer Retina and - Choriocapillaris. Second row: four grey en face OCT images with a black round spot at the crosshair in the first, dark spots with a bright patch in the second, and a bright white blob at the crosshair in the third and fourth. Each en face image carries a red vertical and green horizontal crosshair line with printed index numbers 191 and 133. Bottom: two wide grey B-scan cross-sections, each with a red line along the inner retinal surface and a green line below it, each showing a central dip in the surface. No patient name, date or identification number is visible.

visual.general_description: Two grayscale fluorescein angiogram fields labeled (a) and (b), each a round fundus view with the optic disc on the left.
visual.detailed_description: Panel (a): Round grayscale fundus angiogram with black corners and the printed label (a) beneath it. The optic disc lies at the left edge with brighter fine mottling beside it. Bright, thin branching vessels fan out across the field, with finely branching small vessels in the central-right region. A rounded darker area sits slightly right of centre and a second darker patch lies to its left, between it and the disc. The peripheral field is darker grey. No text other than the panel label is visible. Panel (b): Round grayscale fundus angiogram with black corners and the printed label (b) beneath it. A large bright optic disc lies left of centre with a hazy bright halo, and wide bright vessels arch over it toward the upper right. The background retina is a more uniform mid-grey than in panel (a), with thin branching vessels. A darker rounded area lies right of centre, and a few small bright dots are visible below and to the left of it. No text other than the panel label is visible.
